# Zikun Ye

> Assistant Professor of Marketing at the Michael G. Foster School of Business, University of Washington. My research builds and deploys artificial intelligence.

## About

I am an Assistant Professor of Marketing at the Michael G. Foster School of Business, University of Washington.

My research builds and deploys artificial intelligence. My work spans three threads:

- **LLM-augmented market research** — Augmenting market research with LLMs to do more with less human data, through meta learning, alignment, rectification, and adaptive sampling.
- **Building agentic AI** — Designing AI agent systems for business applications, with attention to orchestration, inference efficiency, and real-world deployment.
- **Data-driven algorithm design** — Combining causal machine learning, optimization, and large-scale field experiments to tackle operations and marketing problems, with deployments at online advertising platforms and marketplaces.

I earned my Ph.D. in Operations Research from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign in 2023, and my Bachelor's degree in Mathematics and Engineering with Zhiyuan honors from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 2018.

- **LOLA: LLM-Assisted Online Learning Algorithm for Content Experiments**. Zikun Ye, Hema Yoganarasimhan, Yufeng Zheng. *Marketing Science*, 2025. Code: https://github.com/DDDOH/LLM_News. https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/abs/10.1287/mksc.2024.0990
- **Deep-Learning-Based Causal Inference for Large-Scale Combinatorial Experiments: Theory and Empirical Evidence**. Zikun Ye, Zhiqi Zhang, Dennis Zhang, Heng Zhang, Renyu Zhang. *Management Science*, 2025. First Prize, INFORMS Social Media Analytics Best Student Paper Award, 2023. https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/full/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04625
- **Efficient Algorithms for a Class of Stochastic Hidden Convex Optimization and Its Applications in Network Revenue Management**. Xin Chen, Niao He, Yifan Hu, Zikun Ye (alphabetical authorship). *Operations Research*, 2024. https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/opre.2022.0216
- **Cold Start to Improve Market Thickness on Online Advertising Platforms: Data-Driven Algorithms and Field Experiments**. Zikun Ye, Dennis Zhang, Heng Zhang, Renyu Zhang, Xin Chen. *Management Science*, 2023. Finalist, INFORMS RMP Section Jeff McGill Best Student Paper, 2020. https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4550
